_doc: Manual corrections for the docs matching, applied by pipeline step 04 after the LLM pass. 'feature' is a slug from data/index/features.json, 'doc_id' an id from data/release-plan/<wave>.json (null = explicitly no match). 'ignore_doc_items' lists doc ids to leave out of the matching and the gap analysis. 'learn_docs' records Microsoft Learn product documentation found by hand for a feature that has no what's new item of its own ({ feature, url, title, documented: yes|partial, checked_at, note }); step 04 copies it to release_plan.learn and the gap report lists these features separately. 'doc_mentions' records where a documented-but-not-shown item was in fact mentioned in passing ({ doc_id, video_id, t, quote, note }).
